Pillar 2 of 4

FDM miniature printing

You do not need a resin printer for tabletop miniatures. My baseline is a 0.2mm nozzle at 0.06mm layers for characters, a 0.4mm nozzle at 0.08mm for rank and file, PLA, full fan, a 15–20° tilt and tree supports.

These are the settings I reached after hundreds of prints, not a copied profile list. I explain what each change did to the model, when it is worth the extra print time, and how to check the result with a caliper rather than a ruler and a hope.
